text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! It delights me to see your ongoing efforts and another spirited training session!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Therefore! I thought I would bring you a little something to show my thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hands me a gift that looks quite expensive.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A tasty selection of morsels! Yes, the finest of iced creams!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I hope this will help relieve some of your fatigue from training in the scorching heat every day!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Do keep this a secret from Tazuna, if you would. Solemnly swear it!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And with that, I shall take my leave!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It is indeed some of the best ice cream we've ever had. Pure melt-in-your-mouth goodness!
